verdict.rationale: Hightouch Events stores collected events in the customer's own warehouse. Syncs can map any SQL model to any of 300+ destinations, so historical event tables could plausibly be sent to a newly added tool. However, no doc explicitly describes a replay, backfill, or full-resync feature. The CDC docs only say that runs send rows changed since the previous run. Missing for 10: an explicit replay/backfill or full-resync capability, documentation of initial-sync behavior that sends full history to a new destination, a recovery path for broken pipelines, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
